chunks: As for what al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah narrated from 'Ali ibn al-Nu'man and Ibn Ribat, from Sa'id al-A'raj, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, he said:

I asked him about the time of Zuhr: is it when the sun declines? He said: After the decline by a foot-length or something near that, except during travel or on the day of Jumu'ah, for its time then is when the sun declines.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, a state affecting the ruling
key_terms.بَعْدَ الزَّوَالِ: after the sun has passed midday
key_terms.بِقَدَمٍ: by the measure of a foot-length, indicating a short delay
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun’s decline from the meridian
key_terms.وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ: the prescribed time of Zuhr salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, for which a special timing is mentioned

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr salat (prayer) begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the beginning time of Zuhr salat (prayer). It indicates that Zuhr generally begins a short while after zawal, measured as about a foot-length, except in travel and on Friday, when its time begins immediately at the sun’s decline.
